function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a given command using the os.system() function specifically for Windows operating systems. For multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For complex tasks, create and run a .bat file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The Windows command line instruction(s) to be executed. Use '&&' between commands for multiple instructions. For complex sequences, encapsulate the logic within a .bat file and provide the execution command here.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to a real‑time clock, so I can’t tell you the current time.
message.reasoning: The user asks "what is the time". We need to respond with the current time. According to system message, we have no real-time clock. But we can approximate? The system says we don't have real-time clock. We can respond that we don't have real-time clock. But maybe we can use the system's knowledge cutoff? That is 2024-06. But we can't know current time. So we should say we don't have real-time clock.
